title: Parts Run
desc: Rico needs a gearbox from the industrial yard before closing. Deliver it to the garage without wrecking it.
intro: Hey, new face! Rico. I run the garage.
I've got a gearbox waiting at the industrial yard. Fetch it and bring it back in one piece.
Careful - it's fragile. Don't wrap it round a lamp post.
outro: Beautiful. Not a scratch. You can drive.
Vera runs the street scene downtown. Go see her - tell her I sent you.

title: Downtown Debut
desc: Vera's first test: a three-checkpoint street race through the city.
intro: Rico vouches for you. That means something.
Three checkpoints, two drivers, one winner. Don't clip the walls.
Ready? Lights go green in three.
outro: Not bad for a rookie. Marcus at the dealership wants a word - he's looking for someone to test his stock.

title: Marcus's Test Drive
desc: Marcus wants a timed lap of the marina loop to see what you're made of.
intro: Marcus Hale. Hale Motors.
I sell fast cars to people who can't drive them. I want a driver who can.
Do the loop inside the time limit and there's money in it.
outro: Hah! Good. Check my showroom whenever you like - your rep opens doors.

title: Kane's Quarter Mile
desc: Kane Voss challenges you to a drag race on the desert strip.
intro: So you're the one Vera keeps talking about.
Kane Voss. I own this strip. Let's see if you can keep up.
Straight line. Loser buys the fuel.
outro: ...Lucky. Next time I won't hold back.

title: Ghost's Package
desc: Collect a sealed case at the ghost town and deliver it to the port. The police are watching - expect heat.
intro: No names. Call me Ghost.
There's a case in the ghost town. Take it to the port.
You'll be followed. Don't stop.

title: Summit Sprint
desc: Vera wants a record up the North Pass to the summit.
intro: The pass. The summit. A hundred hairpins.
Beat the clock and the scene will remember you.
outro: That's a record. Kane will want to know about this.

title: The Apex Finale
desc: Two laps of Apex Speedway against Kane and two of his crew.
intro: Final race. Apex Speedway. Two laps.
Win and the city is yours. Lose and you were never here.
outro: Fine. You're the best driver in the city. Congratulations.

title: Yard Drift
desc: Score 4000 drift points in the industrial yard before time runs out.
intro: Open concrete, nobody watching. Hold a slide and rack up the points.

title: Coast Highway Time Trial
desc: Marlin Bay to the lighthouse along the coast.
intro: Coast road. Salt air. Don't hit the rails.

title: Open Drag Night
desc: Anyone can race the strip - this time a stock sports car waits for you.
intro: Pull up. Straight line. Go.

title: Dune Dash
desc: Hit the checkpoints through the desert dirt tracks. Off-road cars love this.
intro: Dirt, dust and dunes. Suspension upgrades recommended.

title: Pine Ridge Run
desc: Forest roads from Pine Ridge to the farm - time against the clock.
intro: Narrow forest roads. Watch for the trees.

title: Interstate Top Speed
desc: Reach 200 km/h on the East Interstate within 60 seconds.
intro: Straight road. Foot down. 200 on the clock.

title: Thread the Needle
desc: Pull off 6 near misses with traffic in 90 seconds.
intro: Weave through traffic without touching it. Close calls count.

title: Catch Some Air
desc: Stay airborne for a total of 3 seconds - use the hills near the summit road.
intro: Find a crest, floor it, don't land on your roof.

title: Hot Pursuit
desc: Wanted level 3. Lose the police within 4 minutes.
intro: I called in a favour - the cops are on you. Lose them.

title: Maximum Heat
desc: Wanted level 4 with roadblocks. Escape within 5 minutes.
intro: Roadblocks and a hard crew. Think you can handle it?

title: Mountain Cargo
desc: Carry a fragile sports car part from Pinecrest to the summit lookout. Keep damage low.
intro: Tricky roads. Fragile cargo. Drive gently.
